propositions: During a single outbound reconcile pass, per-project effective config is resolved once per ticket instead of once per distinct project, causing redundant filesystem discovery and overlay resolution calls that scale with ticket count rather than project count

A pass-scoped memoization dict keyed by (axis, project_key) can reduce config.effective_* invocations from N (tickets) to M (distinct projects) without changing observable output or introducing process-global state
The _effective_*_for helpers and their callers must thread an optional cache parameter without adding branches or exceeding module complexity/size constraints
Emitted mutations must remain unchanged per-project and reflect each ticket's own project mapping overlay when memoization is enabled
